description: This file defines a class SkewedClockConfigurator that implements ISiloConfigurator for configuring an Orleans silo with a skewed clock service. It sets up a singleton IClock implementation (SkewedClock) with a specified skew range (3 to 5 seconds).

classes.name: SkewedClockConfigurator
classes.description: Implements ISiloConfigurator to configure a silo with a skewed clock service.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the ISiloBuilder to add a singleton IClock service, which is a SkewedClock with specified skew bounds.
